notes: Sound effects made with ElevenLabs sound generation. id -> {prompt, dur (seconds, 0.5-30), influence (0-1, how literally to follow the prompt)}. Game plays them with sfxClip(id). Run: node --env-file=.env tools/make-sfx.mjs A sound can set its own "style" ("" for none). Ids ending _1, _2… are variants: sfxClip('crash') picks one at random.
style: cartoon, funny, bright, kids video game, clean, no music
